rules.sentence: The CUE due to ammonium persulphate can be mediated by the classical pathway (IgG- or IgM-mediated) or by the type 1 (IgE-mediated) pathway.
PCD is chronic hand eczema that occurs in contact with proteins, with or without a positive prick test.[17]
The pathophysiology involves repeated microtrauma to the skin, leading to penetration by large protein molecules.
It involves a type I, type IV, or delayed-phase type I hypersensitivity reaction.
The reaction occurs within minutes of contact, but only 15% reported an immediate-type hypersensitivity reaction.[17][18]
Those who react to specific dietary proteins rarely present with systemic symptoms on oral ingestion.[19]
